# Recorded fixtures: Sackmann tennis archive (unofficial mirror)

A few real rows copied unchanged from the pinned mirror files (Hugging Face dataset
`Aneeshers/tennis-sackmann-archive`, revision `8ac86f7c62889b5d5c4cfec4c6403edcb8c5d993`).
They are used by `tests/test_tennis_history.py` so CI never downloads anything.

Data compiled by Jeff Sackmann / Tennis Abstract (originally github.com/JeffSackmann/tennis_atp and
tennis_wta), licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/).
Unofficial mirror; original repositories withdrawn by the author (404 since about 2026-11-02);
integrity not verified against the original.
